description: The Master of Science in Applied Data Science program at Clarkson is an interdisciplinary program for students with a background in science, mathematics, business or engineering who are seeking to become data scientists. The program provides a strong foundation in data analytics, with courses on topics like machine learning, artificial intelligence, big data and data visualization. Students learn how to apply these techniques to real-world problems in their chosen field. The M.S. in Applied Data Science program at Clarkson University is available in-person or online, allowing students the flexibility to continue working or pursuing other opportunities while they study. The program can be completed on either a full- or part-time basis. This program is STEM designated.
Program name: Master of Science in Applied Data Science

description: A Clarkson MBA develops graduates to become leaders and innovators in a fast-paced, technologically driven global marketplace. Students are challenged by a rigorous curriculum that emphasizes strategic thinking, ethical decision-making, and teamwork. In a Clarkson MBA classroom, students solve real-world problems for real companies, participate in national and international business competitions, and travel abroad on global business trips. The Clarkson MBA is offered on-campus at our Capital Region Campus in Schenectady, NY, and online. Students can choose to study on-campus or online, full-time or part-time. Our on-campus and online programs have the same curriculum and instructors. Our curriculum consists of nine core classes (27 credit hours) and three elective courses (9 credit hours). The core curriculum provides comprehensive coverage of key business functions. This includes the foundations of teamwork and leadership, as well as the analytical skills necessary for business problem-solving and innovation. It also instills the importance of social, ethical and environmental responsibility in today’s business world. Electives can be used to earn a concentration or to customize the program to best meet your needs.
Accreditation status: Accredited by the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB International).
Program name: Master of Business Administration (MBA)

description: As the healthcare industry continues its rapid expansion, so does the demand for well-trained leaders who can improve the business of delivering patient care. Our AACSB-accredited Master of Business Administration in Healthcare Management program provides the crucial business management knowledge and healthcare industry expertise to effectively and efficiently lead a wide variety of healthcare-related organizations. You can select an online or on-campus MBA. The program culminates with a required capstone experience project for a healthcare organization. This hybrid program requires two weekend residencies per year at our Capital Region Campus in Schenectady, New York. You can also meet all requirements for the Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Certification.
Program name: Master of Business Administration in Healthcare Management

description: The Master of Science in Healthcare Data Analytics program is a 36-credit-hour, fully online program for working professionals. The program’s curriculum provides a powerful combination of data analytics skills set in the context of the business of healthcare. Students will learn how to access, manage, analyze and transform data into actionable information that leads to improved patient care, enhanced efficiency and better outcomes. The program will equip students to use data to inform healthcare policy, management and clinical decision-making. Students will use the latest healthcare IT tools, programming languages and analytical software to understand and create data-driven insights. They will have access to a rich selection of industry datasets, case studies and projects.
Program name: Master of Science in Healthcare Data Analytics

description: The Master of Science in Clinical Leadership in Healthcare Management is a 36-credit hour graduate degree that provides students with the business and leadership acumen for a management or leadership role in a clinical healthcare setting. The program is designed to transform the clinical expert into the clinical leader. The curriculum provides a foundation in leadership and the core functional business areas of healthcare management: finance, marketing, data analytics, human resources, quality, etc. The coursework is applied to the clinical setting, and the unique combination of leadership and management gives the clinical expert the skills and knowledge to effectively and efficiently lead the clinical team. The program is offered 100% online in 8-week terms, five times per year. You can begin at any one of five entry points. It can be completed on a part-time basis over two years or in one year on a full-time basis, depending on the number of courses taken per term.
Program name: Master of Science in Clinical Leadership in Healthcare Management

description: The Advanced Certificate in Business is a 15-credit program designed for working professionals who wish to pursue graduate business study but may not be ready to commit to a full master's program. The certificate provides foundational knowledge in key areas of business, including accounting, finance, marketing and management. The certificate also serves as a gateway to the Clarkson MBA. All 15 credits from the Advanced Certificate in Business may be applied to the Clarkson MBA or MBA in Healthcare Management degree programs upon acceptance. The Advanced Certificate in Business is offered online and can be completed in as little as nine months. Students can start in either the fall or spring semesters.
Accreditation status: Clarkson's Reh School of Business is accredited by the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB), an honor that is shared by only 5% of business schools worldwide.
Program name: Advanced Certificate in Business

description: The Advanced Certificate in Business Fundamentals offers a solid foundation in the functional areas of business, including accounting, finance, marketing and operations. The certificate allows for a focus area in either management or data analytics. Students who complete the Advanced Certificate in Business Fundamentals can seamlessly apply their credits to the online MBA program.
Accreditation status: All of our graduate business programs are accredited by the AACSB (Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business).
Program name: Advanced Certificate in Business Fundamentals

description: Our 15-credit-hour Advanced Certificate in Healthcare Management is a non-degree program that gives you a solid foundation in business principles through a healthcare lens. You'll gain a high-level overview of critical areas in healthcare management, including leadership, finance, data analytics and supply chain management. If you're looking for a shorter commitment than a master's degree or want to test the waters before diving into a longer program, this is the perfect option. Should you decide to pursue the Clarkson MBA in Healthcare Management, all 15 credits from your certificate program can be directly applied to your degree. Most students earn their certificate in just one year, making it a quick and effective way to fast-track your career.
Accreditation status: As the business school of a nationally-ranked research university, we are proud to have our school and programs accredited by the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB International).
Program name: Advanced Certificate in Healthcare Management

description: The Advanced Certificate in Human Resource Management (HRM) from Clarkson University will provide you with the fundamental principles of strategic HRM. Courses cover recruitment, training, compensation, employee relations, labor relations, legal issues, and more. The curriculum is aligned with the Society for Human Resource Management (SHRM) HR Curriculum Guidebook and Templates. Students in the program can take the SHRM Certified Professional exam as the capstone of their studies.
Accreditation status: The Reh School of Business at Clarkson University is accredited by the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB International).
Program name: Advanced Certificate in Human Resource Management

description: The Advanced Certificate in Innovation & New Venture Management provides the foundational knowledge and practical business skills necessary to build a new enterprise. Today’s global economy rewards those who can identify market needs and quickly bring products and services to market. The program’s flexible curriculum is designed for those looking to start their own businesses or who want to become valuable assets at an established company. You will learn the best practices and techniques in product innovation, opportunity recognition, lean startups, strategic marketing and financing new ventures. The Reh School of Business is among the top 5 percent of business schools in the world to earn the prestigious AACSB International accreditation. The program is available to be taken completely online, in-person or a combination of both.
Accreditation status: The Reh School of Business is among the top 5 percent of business schools in the world to earn the prestigious AACSB International accreditation.
Program name: Advanced Certificate in Innovation & New Venture Management

description: A five-course, 15-credit-hour program, our Advanced Certificate in Management & Leadership provides graduates with skills in managing data for informed decision-making, in addition to leading, communicating and negotiating. The program is specifically designed to fit the schedules of working professionals. All five courses are offered online. Students also have the option of taking some or all courses in-person at our Capital Region Campus in Schenectady, New York. You can transfer up to three credits to the program, and all 15 credits can be applied to either our MBA or MS in Healthcare Management degree if you decide to pursue a master's.
Accreditation status: Clarkson’s Reh School of Business is accredited by the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB), a distinction that only 5 percent of business schools worldwide have earned.
Program name: Advanced Certificate in Management & Leadership

description: Supply chain management (SCM) is the active management of the flow of goods and services. It includes all processes that transform raw materials into final products, from the point of origin to the point of consumption. Clarkson's nine-credit advanced certificate in SCM provides a solid foundation for those looking to advance or begin their career in this fast-growing field. Our curriculum covers the fundamentals of SCM, such as lean enterprise, operations management and logistics, as well as sustainability, technology management, and project management. The program addresses key SCM areas including: Development and management of a global supply chain. Use of analytics, technology and sustainable practices. Sourcing, procurement, and operations and logistics management.
Program name: Advanced Certificate in Supply Chain Management

description: Clarkson’s Master of Business Administration (MBA) program can make all the difference to your career. Our David D. Reh School of Business is among the top 5 percent of business schools in the world to have earned AACSB accreditation in business and accounting. This means you will graduate with a degree that is highly respected by employers around the globe. Our on-campus MBA program is STEM-designated. Students in this program can specialize in an area such as business analytics or supply chain management and pursue Curricular Practical Training (CPT) to gain valuable on-the-job experience. We are also listed by U.S. News & World Report as one of the best online MBA programs in the nation.
Accreditation status: Our David D. Reh School of Business is among the top 5 percent of business schools in the world to have earned AACSB accreditation in business and accounting.
Program name: Master of Business Administration in Business Analytics

description:
Our Master of Business Administration (MBA) program prepares you for a career in leadership by reinforcing your business fundamentals and focusing on the global supply chain, environmental sustainability and entrepreneurship. You will develop skills in decision-making, risk management, strategic thinking and more.

Take on a leadership role managing supply chains across the globe. We have a world-renowned reputation in supply chain management. The U.S. Army uses our curriculum for its senior logistics personnel. Our program is also ranked among the Top 20 in the nation by U.S. News & World Report. You will study subjects like operations management, strategic sourcing, lean six sigma, logistics and more. Students often earn a Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification as part of their studies.
Accreditation status: All of our business programs are accredited by the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB International).
Program name: Master of Business Administration in Global Supply Chain Management

description: The Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Chemical Engineering is a research-based degree that prepares students to be leaders in the field. Students learn advanced fundamentals and conduct independent research on a cutting-edge topic in chemical engineering. You'll complete the program with a written dissertation and an oral defense. Most students finish in about four years of full-time study after a Master of Science degree or about five years after a Bachelor of Science degree. We are committed to an inclusive and diverse environment. Learn more about our initiatives and campus groups. Our primary research thrusts in chemical engineering are: Advanced Materials Processing, Biomolecular Engineering, Complex Fluids and Nanotechnology, Process and Energy Systems Engineering.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Chemical Engineering

description: The Master of Science (MS) in Chemical Engineering degree from Clarkson is suited to students with a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering or another related field. Our program allows you to deepen your expertise in the field. You will develop a sophisticated understanding of chemical engineering principles and practices. You will learn to apply these advanced concepts to solve complex problems in various industries. You can complete the 30-credit-hour program in one year. Customize your coursework to your career interests. Choose to complete a thesis and conduct research with our renowned faculty. Or opt for a non-thesis, project-based track. You can also further specialize your degree through one of three concentrations. Graduates of this program have gone on to work at companies like Pfizer, GlobalFoundries and Regeneron Pharmaceuticals.
Program name: Master of Science in Chemical Engineering

description: The Department of Civil & Environmental Engineering offers graduate programs leading to the Master of Science (MS), Master of Engineering (ME) and Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) degrees. Our graduate students come from around the world and often go on to be leaders in industry and academia. As a student, you will have opportunities to work closely with our world-renowned faculty on cutting-edge research in a wide array of topics. In particular, we specialize in environmental and water resources engineering, geotechnical and materials engineering, and structural and construction engineering. The doctor of philosophy degree requires a minimum of 90 credit hours beyond the bachelor's degree. A minimum of 39 of these hours must be in coursework. In addition, there are seminar, residency and teaching requirements. You will work with a faculty advisor and advisory committee to plan your coursework and research, and your studies will culminate in a dissertation with a final oral defense.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Civil & Environmental Engineering

Concentration name: Environmental Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Water Resources Engineering, Transportation Engineering
description: Our Master of Science in Civil & Environmental Engineering program is project-based and designed to be completed in one calendar year. Study with and conduct research alongside our world-class faculty. You'll gain advanced skills as you focus on one of five distinct areas of study or create a multidisciplinary plan of study based on your career interests. Students who are admitted to the program are directly admitted into one of the research groups of our faculty. Learn more about their research specializations. You may also qualify for our tuition-scholarship program.
Program name: Master of Science in Civil and Environmental Engineering

description: The Master of Science in Computer Science at Clarkson University allows students to improve their skills and knowledge in computer science and to prepare for professional careers in the field or for further graduate studies. The program offers a flexible curriculum where students can specialize in areas such as artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, data science, human-computer interaction, robotics, software engineering or computer vision. Courses focus on analysis, design and implementation, but do not emphasize programming skills, per se. All students must complete a graduate research project or master's thesis as a part of their studies. You may choose to complete the program at our main campus in Potsdam, New York, or at our Capital Region Campus in Schenectady, New York. You can also start the program at one campus and finish at the other.
Program name: Master of Science in Computer Science

description: The Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) program in computer science at Clarkson is designed for students who wish to pursue a career in research and development in academia, industry or government. The program provides an intellectually stimulating environment, where students can engage in cutting-edge research alongside our expert faculty. A successful PhD student will gain the skills and experience necessary to become a leader in their chosen field.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Computer Science

description: The Master of Science in Construction Engineering Management is an interdisciplinary program jointly administered by the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering and the School of Business. It is designed to prepare students for a wide range of professional careers in the architecture-engineering-construction (AEC) industry. The core curriculum provides students with knowledge of the business and management aspects of the construction industry. As a Construction Engineering Management student, you’ll learn the technical aspects of construction materials, equipment, planning, scheduling and cost estimating. You’ll also develop the managerial skills necessary for a successful career in the construction industry. The coursework integrates construction engineering with business management. You’ll become equipped with the ability to manage complex construction projects.
Program name: Master of Science in Construction Engineering Management

description: The Advanced Certificate in Construction Engineering Management is a 12-credit, four-course sequence designed to be an attractive option for working professionals and graduate students who want specialized knowledge in construction engineering management. The Advanced Certificate in Construction Engineering Management complements our successful Master of Science in Construction Engineering Management. The courses are offered on a rotating basis via distance learning to allow a student to complete the program from any location on a part-time basis. Graduate students matriculated in other programs at Clarkson may also apply for the certificate.
Program name: Advanced Certificate in Construction Engineering Management

description:
The Doctor of Philosophy in electrical and computer engineering program at Clarkson University emphasizes a close working relationship between students and faculty. As a result, our graduate students are highly sought after for positions in industry, research and academia.

The graduate program provides a strong foundation in the fundamentals while encouraging students to pursue cutting-edge research. You can conduct research in one of four primary areas. This includes areas with a large number of faculty, including power and energy systems and communications and signal processing. Read more about research below.

You can also work with faculty outside the department, such as through one of our world-renowned research centers. This includes the Center for Air and Aquatic Resources Engineering and Sciences (CAARES), the Center for Advanced Materials Processing (CAMP) and the Institute for a Sustainable Environment (ISE).

All full-time students in the PhD program are supported with a stipend and tuition waiver, most often through a teaching or research assistantship.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Electrical and Computer Engineering

description: The Master of Science in Electrical and Computer Engineering is a research-based master’s degree program designed to deepen your fundamental knowledge of electrical and computer engineering and support your independent research experience. Our program prepares you for a research-and-development-oriented career or for more advanced studies at the doctoral level. In particular, this degree is intended for students who have a strong aptitude for research and are looking to push beyond the limits of current technologies. You will develop an in-depth understanding of advanced topics in electrical and computer engineering. You will acquire the skills necessary to perform independent research. You will learn how to organize and present your results professionally in both written and oral forms. You will be better prepared to make a long-term impact on society in your field of choice. The program requires 30 credit hours, including six to 12 credit hours of thesis research. The program typically takes four semesters to complete. Students are assigned an advisor in their general area of interest for the first semester. By the end of the first semester, students select their research advisor and thesis topic.
Program name: Master of Science in Electrical and Computer Engineering

description: The Master of Science in Electrical and Computer Engineering is a research-based master's degree program. Our graduate program is flexible and may be tailored to a student's individual interests. Clarkson is a national leader in power engineering education and research. We have seven full-time faculty dedicated to power engineering who are active in research programs with funding from both government and industry. Our graduate power program includes a broad set of courses, including power systems analysis, protection, dynamics and control; power electronics; renewable energy systems and electric machines.
Program name: Master of Science in Electrical and Computer Engineering, Power Engineering Concentration

description: The electric power system is arguably the largest and most complex machine ever built. The engineering challenges are vast, with opportunities ranging from designing the next generation of smart grid technology to developing systems for integrating renewable energy sources. To meet these demands, the Advanced Certificate in Power Systems Engineering program at Clarkson will prepare you for a rewarding career in the power industry. You'll gain a fundamental understanding of power systems and be prepared to perform advanced engineering tasks in your specialty. Through a combination of on-campus and online coursework, this nine-credit-hour program can be completed in as little as nine months, and the curriculum overlaps significantly with our Master of Science in Electrical Engineering program. This allows you to apply what you've learned toward a master's degree, should you choose to continue your education.
Program name: Advanced Certificate in Power Systems Engineering

description: The Master of Science in Engineering Management (MSEM) is an interdisciplinary master's degree program that integrates engineering and business courses. The program is specifically designed to meet the needs of today's engineering professionals who want to lead a team, a project or an organization with excellence. The Clarkson MSEM will prepare you to make important business decisions by understanding and speaking the language of business from the engineering perspective. You will gain a solid foundation in the functional areas of business and will develop analytical and problem solving skills to make strategic decisions. The MSEM is a 30-credit-hour program that provides the knowledge and skills necessary for you to excel in the current global and competitive business environment.
Program name: Master of Science in Engineering Management

description: The Master of Science in Engineering Science (MSES) is a highly flexible, interdisciplinary graduate engineering program. You will build an individualized plan of study from graduate-level courses across multiple engineering disciplines and can even incorporate relevant courses in math and science. The degree is ideal for students whose interests and career goals span traditional engineering fields. It is a research-based, thesis-optional program that requires 30 credit hours of coursework and is best suited for on-campus students at our main campus in Potsdam, New York. Our state-of-the-art facilities offer everything you need to conduct cutting-edge research, while our small class sizes ensure you receive individualized mentorship from faculty who are recognized experts in their fields.
Program name: Master of Science in Engineering Science

description: The Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Environmental Science and Engineering is a research-based degree that prepares students to be leaders in environmental science and engineering. Graduates will go on to pursue careers as faculty members at colleges and universities or as scientists and engineers at national laboratories, consulting firms and nongovernmental agencies. The program is inherently interdisciplinary. This allows students to select courses across the University, including from the Institute for a Sustainable Environment, the Wallace H. Coulter School of Engineering and the School of Arts & Sciences. You will have a broad background in fundamental environmental science and engineering and in-depth expertise in at least one area of specialization.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Environmental Science and Engineering

description: As a student in the Master of Science in Environmental Science and Engineering program at Clarkson, you will gain the advanced knowledge and skills necessary to solve complex environmental problems. You will study in our state-of-the-art facilities, including the world-renowned Institute for a Sustainable Environment (ISE). Through the program, you will learn how to address issues such as air and water pollution, contaminated sites, industrial and hazardous waste management, water resources management, sustainability and renewable energy systems. You can specialize your studies in either science or engineering through our tailored curriculum. And you can get a jumpstart on your professional career via our established relationships with private and government employers.
Program name: Master of Science in Environmental Science and Engineering

description: Materials are all around us, from the concrete in our sidewalks to the glass on our phones. Research at Clarkson in materials science and engineering focuses on advancing the performance of existing materials and developing new ones to help solve some of the world's most pressing issues. Our PhD in Materials Science & Engineering is an interdisciplinary program administered by the Departments of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering, Chemistry and Biomolecular Science, Civil and Environmental Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, and Mechanical and Aeronautical Engineering. As a student in our program, you will have access to our world-class research facilities and the opportunity to work alongside faculty who are experts in their fields. You will also have the opportunity to participate in our research centers, including the Center for Advanced Materials Processing (CAMP), a New York State Center for Advanced Technology.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Materials Science and Engineering

description: The Master of Science in Materials Science and Engineering is a multidisciplinary program aimed at providing a graduate-level education in materials engineering for students with undergraduate degrees in engineering or the physical sciences. The program provides an education in the fundamental science and engineering of materials. It also allows students to specialize in a materials sub-discipline to prepare them for a job in the industry or to continue their education toward a PhD.
Program name: Master of Science in Materials Science and Engineering

description:
The Mechanical Engineering PhD program provides you with the skills and training needed to be a leader in the mechanical engineering industry or in in academia. You will receive an advanced education in the fundamentals of mechanical engineering while also specializing in an area of your choice.
A PhD in mechanical engineering will enable you to make high-level contributions to the field. You can conduct high-level research at a university or a national lab. Or you can pursue a career in industry, including roles in R&D, manufacturing and consulting. Many of our students are also interested in becoming educators.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Mechanical Engineering

Concentration name: Fluid Mechanics, Thermal and Energy Sciences
description: Our Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering is a flexible program that allows you to tailor your curriculum to your specific interests and goals. Core areas of study include solid mechanics, fluid mechanics and robotics. You can choose to write a master's thesis or opt for a non-thesis, project-based track. You can earn the degree in just one year of full-time study. You can also pursue a master's degree part-time. Most classes are held in the late afternoon or evening for the convenience of working professionals.
Program name: Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering

description: Clarkson's one-year Master of Arts in Teaching (MAT) program is designed for individuals who have a bachelor's degree in a specific subject area and want to become a teacher in that subject. The MAT program is field-based and requires two semesters of clinical practice in our partner schools. Our graduates are highly sought-after by school districts throughout New York and other states. We have a nearly 100 percent placement rate, and our alumni have been recognized with state and national teaching awards.
Accreditation status: All teacher education programs are accredited by the Association for Advancing Quality in Educator Preparation (AAQEP).
Program name: Master of Arts in Teaching
Master of Arts in Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages

description: The Master of Science in Occupational Therapy program at Clarkson University provides a strong foundation in the sciences, professional skills, and research and prepares students to become highly skilled, ethical, and compassionate occupational therapists. Students will be prepared to enter a variety of practice settings with a comprehensive understanding of the profession's history, theory, and evidence-based practice. Our curriculum emphasizes hands-on learning, clinical reasoning, and interprofessional collaboration, ensuring that our graduates are well-equipped to meet the diverse needs of their clients and communities. This program culminates in a capstone experience, allowing students to integrate their knowledge and skills in a focused area of practice.
Accreditation status: The entry-level occupational therapy master’s degree program is accredited by the Accreditation Council for Occupational Therapy Education (ACOTE) of the American Occupational Therapy Association (AOTA), located at 6116 Executive Boulevard, Suite 200, North Bethesda, MD 20852-4929. ACOTE’s telephone number c/o AOTA is (301) 652-AOTA and its Web address is www.acoteonline.org. Graduates of the program will be eligible to sit for the national certification examination for the occupational therapist administered by the National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy (NBCOT). After successful completion of this exam, the individual will be an Occupational Therapist, Registered (OTR). In addition, most states require licensure in order to practice; however, state licenses are usually based on the results of the NBCOT Certification Examination. Note that a felony conviction may affect a graduate’s ability to sit for the NBCOT certification examination or attain state licensure.
Program name: Master of Science in Occupational Therapy

description: The Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) program at Clarkson University is a three-year graduate program that prepares students for a career as a physical therapist. Our program combines a strong foundation in the basic and clinical sciences with extensive hands-on experience in our state-of-the-art laboratories and diverse clinical settings. Students in our DPT program learn from expert faculty who are dedicated teachers, clinicians and researchers. Clarkson's DPT program prides itself on a low student-to-faculty ratio, which allows for personalized attention and mentorship. Our curriculum emphasizes evidence-based practice, critical thinking and professional development, ensuring our graduates are well-prepared to meet the challenges of the evolving healthcare landscape. Graduates of our program are highly sought after by employers and have a strong record of success on the national licensure examination. The Doctor of Physical Therapy program begins in the summer and is based at Clarkson's Capital Region Campus in Schenectady, New York.
Accreditation status: The Doctor of Physical Therapy Program at Clarkson University is accredited by the Commission on Accreditation in Physical Therapy Education (CAPTE), 3030 Potomac Ave., Ste 100, Alexandria, VA 22305-3085; phone: 703-706-3245; email: accreditation@apta.org; website: http://www.capteonline.org. If needing to contact the program/institution directly, please call 518-631-9870 or email dpt@clarkson.edu.
Program name: Doctor of Physical Therapy

description:
The Clarkson University Master of Science in Physician Assistant Studies program has a 28-month curriculum that prepares you for a rewarding career as a physician assistant (PA). PAs are licensed medical providers who work in all medical and surgical specialties on healthcare teams with physicians and other providers. Our mission is to educate and develop compassionate, skilled and knowledgeable physician assistants who will provide high-quality healthcare to the people of the North Country and other communities.

The program philosophy is one of commitment to our students and to the communities we serve. Our faculty and staff are dedicated to supporting our students as they learn and grow through our program. Our primary goal is to educate PAs to provide superior medical care and to become leaders in their communities. We expect a high level of professionalism from our students. We are committed to teaching and modeling the importance of teamwork, integrity, intellectual curiosity and caring. We offer our students a variety of educational opportunities in diverse communities in upstate New York. We believe that an awareness of the many challenges of providing medical care in a rural setting is a key component to a comprehensive medical education. We support the communities we serve by teaching our students to be mindful of and to address the social determinants of health that impact the wellness of individuals and communities.
Accreditation status: The Accreditation Review Commission on Education for the Physician Assistant, Inc. (ARC-PA) has granted Accreditation-Continued status to the Clarkson University Physician Assistant Program sponsored by Clarkson University. Accreditation-Continued is an accreditation status granted when a currently accredited program is in compliance with the ARC-PA Standards.
Program name: Master of Science in Physician Assistant Studies

description: The Master of Science in Bioethics is a 31-credit-hour program that introduces students to the major areas of bioethics. Students develop the necessary background and skills to analyze and resolve complex moral problems and dilemmas in medicine, research and health policy. This program provides an excellent foundation for a number of professions including medicine, law, nursing and other allied health professions as well as for those seeking doctoral level work in bioethics or a related field. Students can complete all degree requirements completely online. Students may also begin study in either the fall or spring semester. All graduates of the program complete a major research paper that may be submitted for publication to an academic journal. Students typically complete the program in two years, although it can be completed in as little as 12 months. Each student is also provided with a faculty mentor who assists him or her with all aspects of the program, from course selection to the completion of the major research paper. The Master of Science degree in bioethics is granted jointly by Clarkson University and the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai in New York City.
Program name: Master of Science in Bioethics

description: The Ph.D. in bioscience and biotechnology is an interdisciplinary program that combines strengths in biology and chemistry with engineering to offer a unique doctoral program. The program is a part of the core research focus at Clarkson's Center for Advanced Materials Processing (CAMP) and the Center for Air Resources Engineering and Science (CARES). Doctoral students may also be affiliated with Clarkson's Beacon Institute for Rivers and Estuaries. The program is jointly administered by the Departments of Biology and Chemistry & Biomolecular Science. Research opportunities are provided by Clarkson faculty who are well-recognized and funded in their individual fields. Research focus areas include but are not limited to: Biomaterials, Bioinformatics & Biocomputational Modeling, Environmental Science & Biotechnology, and Molecular & Cell Biology.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Bioscience and Biotechnology

description:
The M.S. in Bioscience & Biotechnology is offered through the Department of Biology in Clarkson's School of Arts & Sciences. The program has a strong research emphasis. It is intended for students with bachelor's degrees who wish to further their training for careers in the rapidly growing fields of bioscience and biotechnology.

Our state-of-the-art facilities offer a rich environment for research. This includes our facilities in the Center for Applied Science & Engineering (CASE), which opened in 2021. The program also draws from our strong connections with biotech companies, including those in the Trudeau Institute business incubator. Our proximity to the Adirondack Mountains provides unique opportunities to study environmental biology and biotechnology.

Our bioscience and biotechnology graduate program is small. This allows for personalized interaction between students and faculty. We offer a thesis-based degree with opportunities for cutting-edge research in a wide range of modern biological disciplines. These include molecular and cell biology, genomics, immunology and biotechnology. Faculty in the Department of Biology are actively engaged in research that crosses disciplines. They also work with faculty in chemistry, engineering and physics. Students are engaged in projects ranging from the development of novel anti-cancer drugs to the study of social behavior. They also explore the genetic basis of diseases and use DNA-based methods to understand ecosystem functioning.
Program name: Master of Science in Bioscience and Biotechnology

Concentration name: Analytical/Inorganic/Physical Chemistry, Biomolecular Chemistry, Materials/Polymer Chemistry, Organic/Medicinal Chemistry
description: The Department of Chemistry and Biomolecular Science offers a program of study leading to the Doctor of Philosophy degree in chemistry. The PhD degree is a research-based degree that requires a dissertation based on original research. It typically takes four to five years to complete the degree requirements. The research specialties of our faculty span the traditional areas of analytical, inorganic, physical, and organic chemistry and biochemistry. Much of our research is interdisciplinary, with active collaborations with faculty from other departments, including biology, physics, chemical engineering, and mechanical engineering. Clarkson's Center for Advanced Materials Processing (CAMP) is another area of active interdisciplinary research and the intellectual center for a number of high-tech industries.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Chemistry

Concentration name: Analytical Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Materials Chemistry
description: The Master of Science in Chemistry is a two-year research-based degree in which students work closely with their research advisors on a research project that will ultimately be submitted for their thesis. Students are prepared to go into a doctoral program or an industrial position. The department has five major research areas: Analytical Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, and Materials Chemistry. Students will take courses in these areas and participate in a vibrant seminar program. Students must pass a series of cumulative exams in their chosen area of study, write a publishable thesis, and defend it to complete the degree.
Program name: Master of Science in Chemistry

description: The Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) program in mathematics is offered through the Department of Mathematics. The Department of Mathematics at Clarkson has a long history of national recognition in applied mathematics. The program provides a broad background in several areas of applied mathematics and expertise in an area of specialization. Students become experienced researchers by completing a dissertation under the direction of a faculty advisor. The PhD in mathematics gives students training and experience that allows them to pursue careers in academia, industry or government.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Mathematics

description:
Our Master of Science in Mathematics program is designed for you if you love math and want to apply it to solve problems in a range of fields. We will prepare you for a professional career in industry or government, or for further graduate study.

Our faculty are active researchers and dedicated teachers in a wide range of areas in both pure and applied mathematics. They are accessible to students and integrate them into research projects. As an MS student, you will have the opportunity to participate in and present your research at seminars and conferences.

We provide a supportive, collaborative environment where you can explore your individual interests. You will complete a thesis or research project in your area of interest under the direction of a faculty advisor.

Our recent graduates have found employment at companies such as the Naval Nuclear Laboratory, The Hartford Insurance, the U.S. Census Bureau and Trans-American Financial. Others have gone on to PhD programs at schools like the University of North Carolina and Baylor University.
Program name: Master of Science in Mathematics

description: The Department of Physics offers a flexible program of study leading to the PhD degree. Students can design a program that best suits their academic and research goals. The physics program offers a diverse curriculum with specialization in many areas of physics. The program also emphasizes collaborative interdisciplinary research. A physics degree prepares students to enter numerous STEM careers in academia, industry and government labs. Clarkson faculty are nationally and internationally recognized for their research. Research is sponsored by federal agencies, including the National Science Foundation, the Department of Energy, the Department of Defense and NASA.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Physics

description:
The Master of Science in Physics degree is awarded upon the successful completion of a minimum of 30 credit hours of graduate work, as specified in one of the options below. At least 20 of these credit hours must be in physics. A cumulative grade point average of at least 3.0 in all graduate courses is required.

Graduate students work closely with faculty mentors in both formal coursework and research. Research opportunities exist in the areas listed below. We have a very active faculty whose research efforts have been recognized by funding from the National Science Foundation, NASA, the Office of Naval Research and the Air Force Office of Scientific Research.

Research Areas

Applied Physics
Astrophysics
Biophysics
Computational Physics
Condensed Matter Physics
Nonlinear Dynamics
Optics
Physics Education
Relativity
Statistical Physics
Program name: Master of Science in Physics

description: As society and industry increasingly face complex issues related to energy production and use, the demand for T-shaped professionals who can bridge the gap between engineering and management in the energy industry has never been greater. The Advanced Certificate in Business of Energy from Clarkson University will give you the knowledge you need to enter the dynamic field of energy.
Program name: Advanced Certificate in Business of Energy

description: The advanced certificate in environmental management provides professionals with the skills needed to make informed decisions that balance environmental concerns and economic realities. The program is ideal for those in the environmental sector who require formal training in management, as well as those in business and other fields who need to expand their knowledge of environmental issues. The coursework offers training in the core areas of environmental regulation, environmental and natural resource economics, environmental systems analysis and project management. The certificate consists of four required courses, all of which are offered online.
Program name: Advanced Certificate in Environmental Management
